server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Public name written to the current Astro server settings section.

max_players.title: Player Slots
max_players.description: Maximum players written to Unreal's GameSession section.

server_password.title: Join Password
server_password.description: Optional password required to join the server.

deny_unlisted_players.title: Deny Unlisted Players
deny_unlisted_players.description: Restricts joining to players accepted by ASTRONEER's server-managed access list.

server_owner_display_name.title: Owner Name
server_owner_display_name.description: Platform display name that ASTRONEER uses to associate the first matching owner.

owner_guid.title: Owner GUID
owner_guid.description: Optional owner platform identifier. ASTRONEER may replace the initial value after the owner joins.

console_password.title: Console Password
console_password.description: A unique password is generated for each new instance. The local console reads online player names and ASTRONEER GUIDs. An empty password disables its TCP port; restart after changing this setting.

public_ip.title: Public IPv4 Address
public_ip.description: Required before starting: the server's public IPv4 address used for native server registration. Saving an incomplete draft is allowed; the app does not guess or automatically publish an address.

load_auto_save.title: Load Autosave
load_auto_save.description: Loads the configured active save automatically when the server starts.

active_save_file_name.title: Active Save Name
active_save_file_name.description: Descriptive save slot selected by ASTRONEER for automatic loading.

backup_save_interval_seconds.title: Backup Interval (seconds)
backup_save_interval_seconds.description: Interval between ASTRONEER's own save backups.

disable_server_travel.title: Disable Server Map Changes
disable_server_travel.description: Prevents map changes requested through Unreal ServerTravel, including the native world-load and reload paths.

max_server_idle_framerate.title: Idle Server Framerate
max_server_idle_framerate.description: Reduced simulation framerate while the server is idle.

wait_for_players_before_shutdown.title: Wait for Players on Exit Request
wait_for_players_before_shutdown.description: When the ExitSemaphore request file exists, waits until no valid player controller remains before saving and quitting. This applies to that file-based shutdown path.

player_activity_timeout_seconds.title: Player Inactivity Timeout (Seconds)
player_activity_timeout_seconds.description: Disconnects players whose recorded inactivity exceeds this many game-world seconds. Set to 0 to disable the inactivity check.

extra_launch_args.title: Extra Launch Arguments
extra_launch_args.description: Optional raw arguments appended after all typed ASTRONEER settings.
